_note: FX exposure registry (added 2026-10-31). Convention: USD/THB = baht per 1 USD; UP = WEAKER baht. direct_foreign = share of the instrument's NAV held in foreign-currency assets (null = unknown). hedge_ratio = share of that foreign exposure hedged back to THB (null = unknown, 0 = unhedged). economic_beta_assumed = % change in the THB value of the position for +1% USD/THB, from how the business earns (assumption, NOT measured). structural=true means the beta follows from the instrument's construction. The engine also measures a beta from price history and reports both. Never fill unknowns by guessing - mark them null and list them as open questions.

PTTEP.BK.hedge_note: Listed THB share: no fund-level hedge concept. Company-level hedging of USD revenue is not modelled (unknown).
PTTEP.BK.confidence: high on direction, medium on magnitude
PTTEP.BK.basis: Upstream oil & gas sold at USD-referenced prices; USD functional currency translated to THB. Weaker baht raises THB earnings. Oil and THB are linked (high oil -> weaker THB), so FX and oil effects must not be added independently.

SCB.BK.hedge_note: Domestic THB lender; no fund-level hedge concept.
SCB.BK.basis: Earnings are local. Negative FX link runs through foreign equity flows: a weakening baht usually comes with foreign selling of Thai banks.

BAFS.BK.basis: THB fee per litre; weak FX link via inbound tourism demand (long lag).

SCBGOLDE.hedge_note: Published FX policy: 'ไม่ป้องกันความเสี่ยงอัตราแลกเปลี่ยน' (does not hedge FX) per Finnomena / Navtable fund pages; feeder into SPDR Gold Trust traded in USD (top holding ~98.8%). SCBAM prospectus wording allows discretionary derivatives for efficient portfolio management, so the hedge ratio is 0 per policy but not contractually fixed. The THB-hedged sibling is SCBGOLDH (hedges 95-105%).
SCBGOLDE.basis: THB NAV = gold in USD x USD/THB (unhedged), so beta to USD/THB is 1.0 by construction.

K-TNZ-ThaiESG.hedge_note: ThaiESG funds must invest mainly in Thai ESG assets, so direct foreign exposure is expected to be ~0, but the latest factsheet has not been checked - unknown.
K-TNZ-ThaiESG.confidence: unknown - measured via SET50 proxy (TDEX) only
K-TNZ-ThaiESG.basis: Thai equity fund; FX link is indirect (foreign flows into SET, exporters/energy holdings). No free look-through.

ES-SETESG-ThaiESG-A.hedge_note: SETESG index fund (Thai listed shares); direct foreign exposure expected ~0 but not verified - unknown.
ES-SETESG-ThaiESG-A.confidence: unknown - measured via SET50 proxy (TDEX) only
ES-SETESG-ThaiESG-A.basis: Tracks SETESG index; FX link indirect via foreign flows and index constituents (energy, exporters, banks).

TDSThaiESG-A.hedge_note: Thai dividend ESG equity fund; direct foreign exposure expected ~0 but not verified - unknown.
TDSThaiESG-A.confidence: unknown - measured via SET50 proxy (TDEX) only
TDSThaiESG-A.basis: Thai dividend equities (banks/energy/utilities heavy); FX link indirect.

usd_listed.basis: USD-listed share/ETF held directly: THB value = USD price x USD/THB.

thai_listed.basis: Thai-listed share with no FX assumption on file; measured beta only.

thai_fif_fund.basis: Thai fund investing abroad (FIF): hedge policy differs by class (H/UH) - check the factsheet before buying.

proposal_rules: Global/US exposure via a Thai FIF fund: prefer to state the class's hedge policy (hedged 'H' vs unhedged 'UH') in every proposal.
Direct US shares/ETFs: count 100% USD exposure, plus FX conversion spread on both legs (see trade_plans.FX_SPREAD).
